moisture_test.interpretation: Positive readings indicate possible wet contact; alert at 10 or higher for two seconds. This measures contact wetness, not humidity or food safety.

note: Temperature range -17.30 to -16.94 C; air range 50 to 51; moisture 0. Quiet motion peak reached 0.208 g. Demo thresholds require physical validation; not food safety limits.

air_test.interpretation: Sanitizer vapor response and alert clearance confirmed; no gas concentration, AQI, or spoilage calibration.

movement_test.interpretation: Controlled cart start/stop crossed the threshold in one recorded sample. Gentle roll did not. Does not establish reliable theft detection.
movement_test.sensitivity_note: Lowered at user request. Observed quiet peak of 0.208 g can trigger this setting.
